The main takeaway from our work is that
the SIMPLE detectors are sensitive to WIMPs with masses of ~5-20 GeV/c^2 and cross sections of ~10^-38 cm^2.
we have now excluded WIMP-nucleon cross sections in excess of 10-38 cm2 at 90% C.L. for a 60 GeV/c2 WIMP mass, which is the most stringent limit to date for spin-independent interactions.
